name: MetricSpot REST API
description:
The MetricSpot REST API lets you run on-demand SEO audits, generate
white-label PDF reports, and render browser-friendly HTML previews for
any URL you own.

Access requires the Pro plan ($49/month) and is capped at 5,000 API
calls per calendar month across all of your tokens. Quota resets on
the 1st of every month.

Most endpoints expect a Bearer API token prefixed with `ms_live_`.
The single anonymous endpoint (`POST /api/public/audit`) is open to
the world and rate-limited by IP.
